data.exact_reserve_text: There were favourable movements during the year of GBP 18.6m (2018: GBP 17.9m ), on prior year gross claims reserves, held at 31 December 2019.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2019 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 155.425m and reports a favourable prior-year movement (release) on gross claims reserves of GBP 18.6m during 2019 (11.97% of opening reserves). The report attributes this to favourable claims development across prior years; no specific loss events or LOB allocations for the movement are provided.
raw_causal_phrases: There were favourable movements during the year of GBP 18.6m (2018: GBP 17.9m ), on prior year gross claims reserves, held at 31 December 2019.
